defects: Wave 6 runners spawn every 60 ticks (1.0 s) instead of 1.5 s (game.py:239).
The run is won when wave 6 has spawned and no walker is left, even if the last runner reached the gate: letting only the last runner through gave screen won, score 660, gate 4 (normal seed 1).
Spanish 'Enter: título' keeps the English key name 'Enter' (it was like this before the change).
